Author: dajoey
Name: Dagobert - Price Matcher
Punchline: Matches (instead of undercuts) market board prices
Description: Fork of Dagobert — matches the lowest market board price instead of undercutting. Default amount is 0 (exact match). You can still set a negative amount to undercut if desired.
Changelog:
v1.12.0.6 - Fork cleanup
- Plugin manifest RepoUrl now points to this fork (dajoey/lalalazy) instead of upstream SHOEGAZEssb/Dagobert.

v1.12.0.4 - Hide inventory context menu entry
- Synced upstream Dagobert v1.14.1.0: new Show inventory context menu entry toggle (on by default) in the config window. Turn it off to remove Dagoberts right-click entry from inventory items.
- Fork behavior preserved: matches the lowest market board price (0 undercut by default); /pricematch command unchanged.
